mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy becomes more accommodative.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS declines (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate exceeding 4.5% signals restrictive monetary policy that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains above 0.03 in such periods.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in unemployment rate and declines in nonfarm payrolls indicate deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction between rising UNRATE and falling PAYEMS does not produce negative 60-day returns (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, declining housing starts signal weakening consumer demand and reduced economic momentum, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative in late-cycle expansion periods despite declining HOUST (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC falls below 0.03 in such regimes.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate trend consistently signals economic weakness and reduced corporate earnings potential, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE rises (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 1500.0 thousand units indicates a significant housing sector slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when HOUST < 1500.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains above 0.03 in such conditions.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in CPI inflation and declines in industrial production indicate stagflationary pressures, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction between rising CPIAUCSL and falling INDPRO does not produce negative 20-day returns (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In supply shock regimes, a sharp decline in industrial production signals reduced economic output and potential inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative during supply shocks despite declining INDPRO (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC falls below 0.03 in such periods.
